dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped structures are visible in the mid-lateral region. These exhibit a diffuse outer perimeter of high-intensity white pixels with a jagged boundary, transitioning via a steep gradient to a dark, low-intensity interior. One structure near the dorsal midline is elongated with an irregular, broken 'C' geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Spatial density of high-intensity white pixel clusters is highest along the dorsal-most ridge, forming an almost confluent zone of solid white. Lower density is observed in the ventral-lateral transition where blobs appear as isolated, asymmetrical polygons with high core pixel concentration.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct central-lateral annuli form an obtuse triangle. The longest leg of the triangle aligns approximately parallel to the dorsal-ventral axis, while the shortest leg connects the central-most annulus to an inferior-posterior blob.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of coalesced high-intensity blobs creates a distinct, vertically-oriented jagged line of contrast located approximately two-thirds of the way toward the posterior end of the visible trunk.
